### Thanks for contributing to sad-chrono-tz!

`sad-chrono-tz 0.10.x` keeps the `chrono-tz 0.10.4` public API stable. Please avoid
semver-incompatible changes, and call out any change in behavior (for example, a panic becoming
an error) in the description.

If the change is a backport of an upstream `chrono-tz` PR, link it and keep the original author on
the commit (`git cherry-pick -x`).

Please consider adding a test to ensure your bug fix or feature will not break in the future.
